tagline.zh: 人机交互节奏 <400ms 时生产力飙升:系统反馈要在 400ms 内到位,或用感知性能(乐观更新、骨架屏)消灭「等」的感觉。
tagline.en: Productivity soars when human-computer interaction stays under 400ms: give feedback within 400ms, or kill the feeling of waiting with perceived performance (optimistic UI, skeletons).

origin.zh: 1982 年 Walter J. Doherty 与 Ahrvind J. Thadani 在 IBM Systems Journal 发表研究,把计算机响应时间要求从沿用已久的 2000ms 降到 400ms;命令在 400ms 内得到回应即「越过 Doherty 阈值」(Jon Yablonski,Laws of UX;调研 07§27)。与 NN/g 0.1/1/10s 三限互为补充:Doherty 定交互节奏,Nielsen 定分层阈值(07§27/§18)。
origin.en: In 1982 Walter J. Doherty and Ahrvind J. Thadani published in the IBM Systems Journal the requirement that computer response time be 400ms, down from the previous 2000ms standard; responses inside 400ms 'exceed the Doherty threshold' (Jon Yablonski, Laws of UX; research 07 §27). It complements NN/g's 0.1/1/10s limits: Doherty sets the interaction cadence, Nielsen the tiered thresholds (07 §27/§18).

effect.zh: 模拟的服务端延迟。默认 700ms:刻意越过 400ms 阈值,让「等」被看见;Doherty & Thadani 1982 的标准是 <400ms(此前行业标准 2000ms)。拖到 ≤400ms,面板徽章翻绿。
effect.en: Simulated server latency. Default 700ms: deliberately past the 400ms threshold so the wait is visible; Doherty & Thadani 1982 set <400ms (previous standard 2000ms). Drag to ≤400ms and the panel badge turns green.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换反馈策略)。wait=按钮「处理中…」干等;optimistic=立即标记完成、后台静默确认(感知性能,07§27);skeleton=内容替换为微光骨架块。
effect.en: JS-type param (the demo subscribes and swaps the feedback strategy). wait = the button shows 'working…'; optimistic = mark done immediately, confirm silently in background (perceived performance, 07 §27); skeleton = content swaps to a shimmering skeleton block.

note.zh: 演示用 setTimeout 模拟延迟、CSS 动画做骨架微光,全现代浏览器可用。
note.en: Latency is simulated with setTimeout and the skeleton shimmer is pure CSS; all modern browsers.

fallback.zh: 阈值不达标时的降级序列:①乐观更新——界面先行,失败再回滚;②骨架屏/进度指示(0.1–1s 用状态反馈,1–10s 用进度条,NN/g 三限);③刻意的微延迟在转账类操作上反而提升信任感(07§27)。真正的服务端优化无法用前端伪装,前端只负责「等的感觉」。
fallback.en: When the threshold can't be met, degrade in order: ① optimistic UI — render first, roll back on failure; ② skeleton/progress indicators (0.1–1s status feedback, 1–10s progress bars, NN/g limits); ③ deliberate micro-delays can even raise perceived trust for money-moving actions (07 §27). Real server latency can't be faked away — the frontend only owns 'the feeling of waiting'.

use.zh: 点赞、收藏、关注等可回滚操作:乐观更新一步到位
use.en: Likes, saves, follows — reversible actions: optimistic UI in one step

use.zh: 列表/卡片首屏:骨架屏占位让布局先行稳定
use.en: First paint of lists/cards: skeletons stabilize layout ahead of data

use.zh: 连续操作的工作流(审批队列、批量处理):节奏压进 400ms
use.en: Continuous workflows (approval queues, batch ops): keep the cadence inside 400ms

avoid.zh: 转账/支付等不可逆操作盲目乐观更新——回滚成本高于等待成本
avoid.en: Blind optimistic UI on irreversible money moves — rollback costs more than waiting

avoid.zh: 用假进度条伪装会超时失败的长任务(违背 07§27 的信任结论)
avoid.en: Fake progress bars masking long tasks that will time out (betraying the 07 §27 trust finding)

a11y.zh: 异步状态必须向辅助技术播报:处理中/完成态用 aria-live="polite" 或 role="status";骨架屏块对读屏是噪声,要配 aria-busy 或等价文本;动效(微光)尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
a11y.en: Async states must be announced: aria-live="polite" or role="status" for working/done states; skeleton blocks are screen-reader noise — pair with aria-busy or equivalent text; the shimmer respects prefers-reduced-motion.

goal.zh: 做一个审批队列演示:5 张待批卡片,点击批准后按可调延迟模拟服务端确认;反馈策略可选「干等/乐观更新/骨架屏」;实时统计单次耗时、完成数,并对 ≤400ms 显示绿色达标徽章。
goal.en: Build an approval-queue demo: 5 pending cards; approving triggers a simulated server confirmation at adjustable latency; feedback strategy selectable among plain wait / optimistic UI / skeleton; live per-action timing and a green ≤400ms badge.

acceptance.zh: delay 为 CSS 变量型参数,demo 内 setTimeout 直接读取参数值(经 store)
acceptance.en: delay is a CSS-var-type param; the demo's setTimeout reads the current store value

acceptance.zh: feedback 为 JS 型参数:wait/optimistic/skeleton 三种策略视觉可区分
acceptance.en: feedback is a JS-type param: wait/optimistic/skeleton visually distinct

acceptance.zh: ≤400ms 时显示「Doherty 达标」徽章,>400ms 显示超时警示
acceptance.en: ≤400ms shows a 'within Doherty' badge; >400ms shows the overtime warning

acceptance.zh: 异步状态经 aria-live 播报;骨架微光尊重 prefers-reduced-motion
acceptance.en: Async states announced via aria-live; skeleton shimmer respects prefers-reduced-motion

acceptance.zh: 乐观更新演示必须包含「确认/回滚」两个阶段,而非一蹴而就
acceptance.en: The optimistic demo must show both confirm/rollback phases, not an instant jump
